coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: 1470 Owens Street
record.summary: 1470 Owens Street is a UCSF parking structure at Mission Bay serving multiple UCSF life-science buildings and the adjacent Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices, designed by WRNS Studio. DataSF Assessor records and the project's structural engineer both date its completion to 2020.

1470 Owens Street added as a real status.csv record: a UCSF parking structure (designed by WRNS Studio) serving nearby UCSF life-science buildings and the adjacent Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices, identified by the owner during the same positioning-review batch. Confirmed via the structural engineer's own project page and a parking-facility listing. DataSF's Building Footprints layer has no captured footprint at all for this parcel, so the real Assessor parcel boundary is used directly.

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2020 completion is not sourced, only the year.

A separate WRNS Studio project page (wrnsstudio.com/projects/ucsf-parking-structure/) lists a 'UCSF Mission Bay Parking Structure' completed in 2012 -- this conflicts with the 2020 date and, given the address-specific Watry Design page and the Assessor's own parcel-tagged year both agree on 2020, is treated here as describing a different, earlier UCSF Mission Bay garage (there is more than one on the campus, e.g. the separately-listed Owens Street Garage at 1625 Owens St), not this parcel. Not independently confirmed which building the WRNS page depicts.

record.notes: 1470 Owens Street -- a UCSF parking structure serving multiple UCSF Mission Bay life-science buildings and the adjacent Kaiser Permanente Mission Bay Medical Offices (1600 Owens St), designed by WRNS Studio; garage entrance on Nelson Rising Lane off Owens St. Features a green-wall security screen and 25 EV charging spaces (per the structural engineer's own project page and ParkChirp's facility listing). Owner-identified while reviewing the numbered real-gap-fragment map for this session's positioning check. DataSF Assessor confirms blklot 8709019 at 1470 Owens St; this record uses the real Assessor parcel boundary (the DataSF Building Footprints layer has no captured footprint at all for this parcel, likely a parking-structure gap in that dataset).
